Otter.ai Otter.ai has firmly established itself as a go-to platform for real-time meeting transcription and collaborative note-taking. Its core strength lies in the OtterPilot, an AI meeting agent that can automatically join your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls. It generates live transcripts, identifies different speakers, and captures presentation slides automatically. This makes it one of the best AI transcription software solutions for teams that rely heavily on virtual meetings. The platform is built around creating a "single source of truth" for meeting conversations. After a call, Otter provides an automated summary, a list of action items, and a searchable transcript, which team members can comment on and highlight. This collaborative aspect is a key differentiator, turning a simple transcript into an interactive workspace. Key Features and Use Cases Live Transcription & OtterPilot: The AI agent joins meetings for you, providing a real-time transcript so participants can focus on the discussion instead of taking notes. Automated Summaries: After the meeting, you get a concise summary delivered straight to your email, perfect for quickly catching up. Collaboration Tools: Teams can highlight, add comments, and assign action items directly within the transcript. Best For: Sales teams reviewing calls, project managers tracking next steps, and educators providing accessible lecture notes. Otter.ai offers a free tier with limited transcription minutes per month. Paid plans unlock more minutes, advanced features like the OtterPilot, and greater collaboration capabilities. While its language support is best for English, the user interface is polished and intuitive, making it easy to get started. You can learn more about its role in the market by exploring various AI-powered transcription software options. Pros: Excellent for live meeting transcription and collaboration. Polished UI and seamless integration with major calendar/meeting apps. Offers a functional free tier for testing. Cons: Most advanced AI features are locked behind higher-priced tiers. Language support is not as broad as some competitors. 3. Rev.com Rev.com stands out in the transcription market by offering a powerful hybrid model. It combines fast, affordable AI-powered transcription with a premium, 99%-accurate human transcription service, making it a uniquely flexible platform. This dual approach allows users to choose the right tool for the job, whether they need a quick draft from an automated engine or a polished, publication-ready transcript reviewed by a professional. This makes Rev one of the best AI transcription software solutions for professionals who require a mix of speed and guaranteed accuracy. You can use the AI for internal notes or first drafts and then easily upgrade to human transcription for critical files like legal proceedings, final video captions, or public-facing content where precision is non-negotiable. Key Features and Use Cases Hybrid AI & Human Services: Access both automated transcription (starting at $0.25/minute) and human transcription (starting at $1.50/minute) from a single platform. Guaranteed Accuracy: The human service offers a 99% accuracy guarantee, which is crucial for compliance, legal, and academic use cases. Comprehensive Offerings: Beyond transcription, Rev provides human-powered captions, foreign subtitles, and a new AI Notetaker for meetings. Best For: Legal professionals needing certified transcripts, video producers requiring flawless captions, and businesses that need both quick AI drafts and high-accuracy human outputs. Rev offers both pay-as-you-go pricing and subscription plans for its AI services, providing flexibility for different usage levels. While the human services come at a premium cost, the platform's reliability and clear turnaround times justify the investment for high-stakes projects. You can explore how Rev's human-in-the-loop model compares to other options when choosing transcription software for interviews. Pros: Flexible mix of high-speed AI and high-accuracy human services. Clear pricing and guaranteed 99% accuracy on human transcription. Strong reputation for quality, especially for professional and media use. Cons: Human services are significantly more expensive than AI-only competitors. The automated AI transcription is not as feature-rich as some dedicated AI platforms. 4. Descript Descript redefines transcription by integrating it directly into an all-in-one audio and video editor. Its core innovation is "text-based editing," where you edit your media by simply editing the transcript, like a word document. Deleting a sentence from the text automatically removes the corresponding audio or video segment. This unique workflow makes it one of the best AI transcription software choices for content creators, particularly podcasters and video editors. The platform goes far beyond simple transcription, offering a suite of AI-powered tools designed to streamline the entire production process. Features like "Studio Sound" enhance audio quality with one click, while "Overdub" allows you to create an AI clone of your voice to correct mistakes. The seamless blend of a powerful transcription engine with a full-featured media editor sets Descript apart as a comprehensive content creation hub. Key Features and Use Cases Text-Based Media Editing: Edit audio and video files by manipulating the transcript, making post-production intuitive and fast. AI-Powered Tools: Includes one-click filler word removal (e.g., "um," "uh"), Studio Sound for audio enhancement, and AI-generated summaries and clips. Overdub Voice Cloning: Correct recording errors or add new words by typing them, using a realistic AI clone of your own voice. Best For: Podcasters, YouTubers, and video editors who need to edit content based on its transcript, as well as teams collaborating on media projects. Descript offers a free plan with limited transcription hours to test its core features. Paid plans unlock more transcription time, advanced AI tools, and collaborative features for teams. While the full editor has a learning curve, its power to merge transcription with creation is unmatched. Pros: Combines editing and transcription into a single, efficient workflow. Excellent suite of AI tools for creators (filler word removal, Overdub). Generous free tier is available to try the core functionality. Cons: The full feature set can present a learning curve for new users. Transcription and media-hour limits are based on your subscription plan. 5. Sonix.ai Sonix.ai is engineered for speed and precision, offering automated transcription and translation services tailored for media professionals and global teams. Its core strength is a powerful in-browser editor that synchronizes audio/video with a timestamped transcript, making it simple to review, edit, and perfect the text. The platform excels at processing large volumes of files and is a strong contender for the best AI transcription software for content creators who need to repurpose media into different formats quickly. The platform supports over 40 languages and dialects, along with translation capabilities, making it a versatile tool for international collaboration. Its collaborative features allow multiple users to work on a transcript simultaneously, leaving comments and notes. This makes it ideal for production houses, marketing agencies, and journalists who need to work together on tight deadlines to produce accurate subtitles, captions, and written content from audio or video sources. Key Features and Use Cases In-Browser Editor: A robust editor that allows for easy editing with word-by-word timestamping and speaker diarization. Multi-language Transcription & Translation: Transcribe in over 40 languages and then translate the transcript to dozens more, expanding content reach. Collaboration Tools: Invite team members to view and edit transcripts, streamlining the review and approval workflow. Best For: Journalists transcribing interviews, podcasters creating show notes, and video producers generating accurate subtitles and captions. Sonix.ai offers flexible pricing with both pay-as-you-go hourly rates and discounted monthly subscriptions. While some advanced AI analysis features may come at an extra cost, its core transcription and collaboration tools are highly effective. You can learn more by visiting the Sonix.ai website. Pros: Flexible pricing models (per hour or subscription). Precise diarization and strong export format support (SRT, VTT). Good for batch work and team collaboration. Cons: Some AI analysis features can cost extra. Storage allocation varies significantly by plan. 6. Trint Trint is an enterprise-grade transcription platform built with journalists, content creators, and large teams in mind. Its core strength lies in its powerful collaborative workflow, which allows users to transcribe, edit, highlight, and verify audio and video content securely. The platform excels at turning raw recordings into structured, searchable data, making it one of the best AI transcription software solutions for editorial and production environments where speed and accuracy are paramount. The platform is designed around a "Story Builder" workflow, enabling teams to pull key quotes from multiple transcripts to craft narratives, scripts, or articles. Trint's robust search functionality lets users instantly find moments across their entire content library. With extensive language support and enterprise-level security, it provides a comprehensive solution for organizations managing high volumes of sensitive audio and video files. Key Features and Use Cases Live & Automated Transcription: Capture real-time audio from events or upload files in bulk using the API and BulkScribe for high-volume ingestion. Extensive Language Support: Transcribes in over 40 languages and offers translation into more than 70 languages, ideal for global teams and international content. Collaborative Workflows: Teams can highlight, comment, and verify transcripts together, with a Story Builder for creating narratives from key moments. Best For: Newsrooms, media production houses, research institutions, and large enterprises that need a secure, scalable, and collaborative transcription environment. Trint's pricing is geared towards teams and enterprise clients, with specific costs often requiring a sales consultation. While this makes it less accessible for individual users, the feature set is tailored for professional-grade workflows where security, collaboration, and high-volume processing are non-negotiable. Pros: Strong focus on editorial and newsroom-oriented workflows. Enterprise security options and bulk ingestion capabilities. Excellent for high-volume and collaborative team environments. meta_description: تکنولوژی تبدیل گفتار به نوشتار Speech-to-Text به یکی از ابزارهای ضروری برای کسب‌وکارها، پژوهشگران و کاربران عادی تبدیل شده است.
content: راهنمای جامع استفاده از Speech-to-Text برای زبان فارسی در عصر دیجیتال امروز، تکنولوژی تبدیل گفتار به نوشتار (Speech-to-Text یا STT) به یکی از ابزارهای ضروری برای کسب‌وکارها، پژوهشگران و کاربران عادی تبدیل شده است. این فناوری با استفاده از هوش مصنوعی و الگوریتم‌های پیشرفته، قادر است صدای انسان را به متن قابل خواندن تبدیل کند. برای زبان فارسی که دارای ویژگی‌های خاص خود است، استفاده از این تکنولوژی چالش‌ها و فرصت‌های منحصر به فردی را به همراه دارد.Speech-to-Text چیست؟تبدیل گفتار به نوشتار، فرآیندی است که طی آن صدای انسان با استفاده از تکنولوژی‌های پردازش صوت و یادگیری ماشین به متن قابل خواندن تبدیل می‌شود. این فناوری که به آن ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) نیز گفته می‌شود، امروزه در کاربردهای مختلفی از جمله:تایپ صوتی و دیکته کردن متونزیرنویس‌گذاری خودکار ویدیوهارونویسی جلسات و مصاحبه‌هادستیارهای صوتی هوشمندابزارهای کمکی برای افراد دارای معلولیتاستفاده می‌شود.چالش‌های Speech-to-Text در زبان فارسی1. تنوع لهجه‌ها و گویش‌هازبان فارسی دارای لهجه‌ها و گویش‌های متنوعی است که این موضوع پردازش صوت را پیچیده‌تر می‌کند. سیستم‌های STT باید قادر به تشخیص گفتار با لهجه‌های مختلف مانند تهرانی، اصفهانی، شیرازی و غیره باشند.2. کمبود دیتاست‌های فارسیدر مقایسه با زبان‌های بین‌المللی مانند انگلیسی، تعداد دیتاست‌های صوتی فارسی با کیفیت مناسب محدودتر است که این امر توسعه مدل‌های دقیق را با چالش مواجه می‌کند.3. پیچیدگی‌های دستوری و نگارشیزبان فارسی دارای ویژگی‌هایی مانند حروف چسبان، علائم اعرابی و کلمات مرکب است که پردازش آن را پیچیده‌تر می‌کند.4. صحبت‌های محاوره‌ای و رسمیتفاوت قابل توجه بین زبان محاوره‌ای و رسمی در فارسی، نیازمند مدل‌هایی است که قادر به تشخیص و پردازش هر دو نوع گفتار باشند.سرویس‌های موجود برای Speech-to-Text فارسی1. سرویس‌های ایرانیالف) ای‌او‌تایپ (IoType)یکی از محبوب‌ترین سرویس‌های ایرانی که امکانات زیر را ارائه می‌دهد:تایپ صوتی آنلاین با دقت بالاپشتیبانی از لهجه‌های مختلف فارسیAPI برای توسعه‌دهندگانیادگیری از صدای کاربر برای افزایش دقتامکان تعریف علائم و عبارات سفارشیب) فارس‌آواسرویس بومی دیگری که ویژگی‌های زیر را دارد:سرعت بالا در Uygulaması sayesinde kolayca erişilebilir, anında görsel çeviri ve konuşmadan metne dönüştürme özellikleriyle de oldukça esnek. Birçok gezginin, yabancının ve hatta girişimcinin hayatını kurtardığına hiç şüphe yok!Makine öğrenimini kullanan bu teknoloji, içeriği farklı dillere çevirmek isteyen web siteleri için son derece kullanışlıdır. Google Translate API kurarak Google'ın sinir ağını kullanabilir ve içeriğinizi Google Cloud üzerinden çevirebilirsiniz.Ancak Google Translate her kullanım durumu için pratik değildir. Özellikle, web sitenizi, e-ticaret mağazanızı, blogunuzu vb. çevirmek için ideal değildir. Nimdzi ile makine çevirisinin durumu üzerine yaptığımız araştırmadan da görebileceğiniz gibi, Google Translate özellikle belirli dil çiftleri için çok iyi alternatifler var. Bu yazıda, bu alternatiflere, bunlara ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz diğer nedenlere ve web sitenizi çok dilli hale getirmenin etkili bir yoluna bakacağız.Google Translate'e alternatiflerWeb siteniz Google Translate kullanmanın diğer alternatiflerine bir göz atalım:DeepLDeepL, makine çevirisi konusunda önde gelen bir isim ve özellikle Google ile karşılaştırıldığında doğruluğuyla çok beğeniliyor. Bağlamı ve günlük konuşma dilini daha iyi anladığı için çevirileri düzenlemenize bile gerek kalmıyor. İlginç bir bilgi: Kaliteli çevirileriyle tanınan popüler çevrimiçi çok dilli sözlük Linguee ile birlikte geliştirilmiş.Örneğin, DeepL aşağıdaki dil Google Translate ten daha yüksek kaliteli çeviriler sunmaktadır: İngilizce-Almanca, İngilizce-Fransızca ve İngilizce-İspanyolca. DeepL ve Google Translate karşılaştıran kendi araştırmamızda da DeepL'in, insan tarafından doğrulanması gerekmeyen en fazla sayıda çeviri ürettiği ortaya çıktı.Ayrıca DeepL, Google Translate gibi otomatik web sitesi çevirisi API bir API sağlar. Web arayüzünü ve uygulamalarını kullanarak metin dosyalarını (.pdf, .docx ve hatta .pptx dosyaları) ve metin içeriklerini de çevirebilirsiniz.Ancak, Google Translate DeepL'e göre Google Translate bir üstünlüğü, geniş dil seçeneğidir. DeepL şu anda 30 dili desteklemektedir ve yakın zamanda Arapça da eklenmiştir. 800 dil çifti sunuyor ki bu da birçok web sitesi sahibi için oldukça yeterli. Bu dillerin çoğu Lehçe ve Portekizce gibi Avrupa dilleri olsa da, DeepL Çince, Endonezce, Türkçe, Japonca ve Korece'yi de destekliyor.Son olarak, DeepL API her ay 500.000 karakteri ücretsiz olarak API ve belirli diller için 1.000 sözlük API . Bir sonraki seviye olan DeepL API , aylık 4,99 €'dur. Hacim kısıtlaması yoktur, maliyet kontrol ayarları vardır ve 1.000.000 karakter başına 20 € ödeyerek kullandıkça öde sistemine sahiptir . Google da neredeyse aynı şeyi sunuyor: ayda 500.000 karakter ücretsiz ve bir milyon karakter için 20 dolar ücret alıyor. Ancak, çeviri için gönderdiğin bir belgenin her sayfası için 0.08 dolar talep ediyor.Microsoft TranslateMicrosoft'un Bilişsel Hizmeti aracılığıyla sunulan Microsoft Translate, Bing, Office, Microsoft Edge ve daha birçok tanıdık üründe bulunuyor. Microsoft Translator, Google Translate güçlü bir rakibidir. Google'ın 133 diline yakın bir şekilde 129 dili desteklemektedir. Ayrıca, Nimdzi ile birlikte web siteleri için makine çevirisinin durumu üzerine yaptığımız araştırmada da iyi bir performans göstermiş ve yedi dilin tümü için genel kullanılabilirlik ve derecelendirme sıralamasında 4 üzerinden 3 puan almıştır. Ek bir avantaj olarak, test edilen tüm dillerde tutarlı bir şekilde yüksek puan alan tek çeviri sağlayıcısıydı.Almanca çevirilerde düzenleme gerektirmeyen sonuçlar üretmede de en yüksek puanı aldı; hatta bu dildeki doğruluğu ve kalitesiyle çok övülen DeepL ile karşılaştırıldığında bile!Web sitenizde nasıl çalıştığını görmek için ücretsiz API ile birlikte gelir. Bunun dışında, ücretsiz planı ile ayda 2 milyon karakter çevirebilirsiniz, oysa Google Translate ile ayda sadece 500.000 karakter Google Translate . Eğer 2 milyon karakterden fazlasına ihtiyacın olursa, Microsoft Translator yine daha uygun fiyatlı çıkıyor: 1 milyon karakter için 10 dolar alırken, Google 20 dolar talep ediyor.Amazon TranslateAmazon Translate, e-ticaret devinin makine çevirisi hizmeti olup, bulut tabanlı hizmet paketi olan Amazon Web Services'ın bir parçası. Bunu diğer alternatiflerden ayıran özellik, yalnızca AWS Yönetim Konsolu veya bir API üzerinden erişilebilmesidir. Dolayısıyla, Google, DeepL ve Microsoft'ta olduğu gibi hareket halindeyken çeviri yapmak için kullanamazsınız.Amazon Translate'i web siteni çevirmek, belgeleri çevirmek, özel terminoloji oluşturmak, dildeki resmiyetleri yapılandırmak ve hatta küfürleri sansürlemek için kullanabilirsin. Ayrıca 75 dili ve 5.500'den fazla çeviri kombinasyonunu destekliyor.Üstelik, e-posta, yardım masası, sohbet ve biletleme uygulamalarında gerçek zamanlı çeviri sağlıyor, böylece temsilciler müşterilerinin dillerinde iletişim kurabiliyor.Amazon Translate, hızla yüksek kaliteli bir makine çevirisi sağlayıcısı haline geliyor. Nimdzi ile yaptığımız araştırmada, burada gördüğünüz grafikte de olduğu gibi, 'dokunulmamış' çevirilerde en yüksek puanlardan birini aldı. Bu da çevirmenlerin Amazon Translate'in çıktısını diğer bazılarına göre çok daha az düzelttiği anlamına geliyor.Eğer AWS Ücretsiz Katmanına kaydolduysan, ilk çeviri talebini yaptığın günden itibaren 12 ay boyunca Amazon Translate'e ücretsiz erişebilirsin. Ayrıca, standart metin ve toplu belge çevirisi için her ay 2 milyon karakter alacaksın.Ancak, bu katmana kaydolmadıysan, standart metin, toplu belge ve gerçek zamanlı belge çevirisi (metin ve HTML) için 1 milyon karakter başına 15 dolar ödemen gerekecek. 术语干预：强制保留专业术语不被误翻 - 上下文翻译：利用前后句信息提升语义连贯性 - 格式化翻译：自动保留原文标点、数字、代码等结构 2.2 为何选择 HY-MT1.5-1.8B？ 尽管 HY-MT1.5-7B 在翻译质量上更具优势，但其对算力要求较高，通常需多卡A100或H100才能流畅运行，难以部署在边缘侧。 相比之下，HY-MT1.5-1.8B 虽然参数量仅为7B版本的约1/4，但在多个基准测试中达到了与其相当的BLEU分数，尤其在日常对话、新闻资讯类文本中差距小于1个点。更重要的是： 维度HY-MT1.5-1.8BHY-MT1.5-7B参数量1.8B7B推理显存占用（FP16）~3.6GB~14GB单句翻译延迟（平均）<80ms~200ms是否支持INT4量化✅ 是❌ 否边缘设备部署可行性✅ 高⚠️ 中 💡 结论：对于需要低延迟、离线运行、资源受限的应用场景（如手持翻译机、AR眼镜、车载系统），HY-MT1.5-1.8B 是更优选择。 3. 实践部署：从镜像启动到网页推理 本节将手把手带你完成 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 的完整部署流程，适用于个人开发者或企业原型验证。 3.1 环境准备与硬件要求 推荐配置 GPU：NVIDIA RTX 4090D / 3090 / A10G（显存 ≥ 24GB）显存需求：INT4量化后仅需约 2.1GB 显存操作系统：Ubuntu 20.04 或更高版本Docker：已安装并配置好 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 📝 说明：虽然模型本身可在低显存设备运行，但部署镜像包含完整推理服务和前端界面，建议使用单卡4090D及以上配置以获得最佳体验。 3.2 部署步骤详解 步骤一：获取并运行部署镜像 CSDN星图平台已预置 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 完整推理镜像，支持一键拉取与启动。 # 拉取镜像（假设镜像ID为 csdn/hy-mt15-1.8b:v1）docker pull csdn/hy-mt15-1.8b:v1 # 启动容器（映射端口8080）docker run -d --gpus all \ -p 8080:8080 \ --name hy-mt-1.8b \ csdn/hy-mt15-1.8b:v1AI写代码bash 🔍 命令解析： - 随着全球化进程的加速，跨语言交流在旅游、商务、教育等场景中变得愈发重要。尤其是在自由行日益普及的背景下，游客对实时、准确、低延迟的多语言翻译服务需求激增。传统云端翻译方案受限于网络稳定性与隐私安全问题，难以满足移动化、便携式设备的部署要求。在此背景下，腾讯开源的混元翻译大模型 HY-MT1.5 提供了全新的技术路径——其轻量级版本 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 经过量化优化后，可高效运行于边缘计算设备，为智能翻译机、AR眼镜、手持导游仪等终端提供本地化实时翻译能力。 本文将聚焦 HY-MT1.5 在旅游场景下的落地实践，重点探讨如何将其集成至嵌入式语音翻译设备中，实现离线环境下的高质量多语种互译，并结合实际工程经验，给出从模型选型、部署优化到系统整合的完整解决方案。 1. 模型介绍与技术背景 1.1 HY-MT1.5 系列模型架构概览 混元翻译模型 1.5 版本（HY-MT1.5）是腾讯推出的开源大规模神经机器翻译模型系列，包含两个核心变体： HY-MT1.5-1.8B：参数量约为 18 亿，专为边缘侧和移动端优化设计HY-MT1.5-7B：参数量达 70 亿，基于 WMT25 夺冠模型升级而来，面向高精度翻译任务 两者均支持 33 种主流语言之间的互译，涵盖英语、中文、日语、韩语、法语、西班牙语、阿拉伯语等国际常用语种，并特别融合了藏语、维吾尔语、蒙古语、壮语、彝语等 5 种中国少数民族语言及其方言变体，显著提升了在多元文化区域的应用适配性。 模型名称参数规模推理速度（CPU）是否支持边缘部署典型应用场景HY-MT1.5-1.8B1.8B快（<200ms/句）✅ 支持量化部署实时语音翻译、移动App、IoT设备HY-MT1.5-7B7B较慢（需GPU加速）❌ 建议云端使用高质量文档翻译、会议同传系统 1.2 核心能力升级：超越基础翻译的功能拓展 相较于早期版本，HY-MT1.5 系列引入了三大关键功能，极大增强了在复杂旅游场景中的实用性： 术语干预（Term Intervention） 允许预定义专业词汇映射规则，例如将“兵马俑”固定翻译为 "Terracotta Warriors" 而非直译，避免歧义。 上下文翻译（Context-Aware Translation） 利用对话历史或前后句信息进行语义消歧。如“这里很热”可根据前文判断是指气温还是人流拥挤程度。 格式化翻译（Preserve Formatting） 自动保留原文中的时间、数字、货币、专有名词等结构化内容，确保输出符合目标语言习惯。 这些特性使得模型不仅能处理孤立句子，还能应对连续对话、景点解说、菜单翻译等真实旅游交互场景。 2. 技术选型：为何选择 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 用于旅游设备？ 2.1 场景需求分析 在旅游类智能硬件开发中，我们面临以下典型挑战： 网络不可靠：景区、地铁、山区常无稳定Wi-Fi或蜂窝信号响应延迟敏感：用户期望语音输入后 300ms 内获得反馈功耗限制严格：手持设备电池容量有限，不能持续高负载运行多语言覆盖广：需支持至少 10+ 主要入境/出境旅游语种隐私保护要求高：用户对话不宜上传至第三方服务器 因此，理想的翻译模型必须具备：本地运行能力 + 低内存占用 + 快速推理 + 多语言支持。 2.2 对比主流方案的技术权衡 方案类型代表产品是否离线延迟多语言支持隐私性成本商业API（Google Translate）云调用❌ 否中~高✅ 强❌ 数据外传按调用量计费开源大模型（M2M-100）本地部署✅ 是高（>1s）✅ 强✅ 本地处理免费但资源消耗大小型NMT模型（FairSeq Tiny）本地部署✅ 是低⚠️ 有限✅ 本地处理免费但质量差HY-MT1.5-1.8B（量化版）本地部署✅ 是✅ <200ms✅ 强✅ 本地处理✅ 免费开源 可以看出，HY-MT1.5-1.8B 在性能与效率之间实现了最佳平衡，尤其适合部署在算力受限的嵌入式平台。 3. 实践落地：构建基于 HY-MT1.5 的实时语音翻译设备 3.1 系统架构设计 我们设计了一套完整的端侧翻译系统，整体架构如下： [麦克风] ↓ (音频采集)[ASR语音识别模块] → [文本预处理] ↓ [HY-MT1.5-1.8B 翻译引擎] ↓ [TTS语音合成模块] → [扬声器播放]AI写代码 其中： - ASR 使用 Whisper-tiny 或 Paraformer 实现本地语音转文字 - TTS 可选用 VITS 或 FastSpeech2 实现自然语音生成 - 核心翻译模块由 量化后的 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 承担，运行于设备 SoC 的 NPU/GPU 上 3.2 模型部署流程详解 步骤一：获取并加载模型镜像 目前可通过 CSDN 星图平台一键部署 HY-MT1.5 模型镜像： # 示例：通过 Docker 启动本地推理服务（适用于开发调试）docker run -p 8080:8080 csdn/hy-mt1.5-1.8b:latestAI写代码bash 该镜像已集成以下组件： - PyTorch 2.1 + Transformers 库 - 支持 INT8 量化的模型权重 - RESTful API 接口 /translate，支持 JSON 请求 步骤二：调用翻译接口（Python 示例） import requestsimport json def translate_text(text, src_lang="zh", tgt_lang="en"): url = "http://localhost:8080/translate" payload = { "text": text, "source_lang": src_lang, "target_lang": tgt_lang, "context": [], # 可传入历史对话提升准确性 "terms": {"故宫": "The Forbidden City"} # 自定义术语表 } headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} response = requests.post(url, data=json.dumps(payload), headers=headers) if response.status_code == 200: result = response.json() return result['translated_text'] else: raise Exception(f"Translation failed: {response.text}") # 使用示例chinese_input = "请问最近的地铁站在哪里？"english_output = translate_text(chinese_input, "zh", "en")print(english_output) # Output: Excuse me, where is the nearest subway station?AI写代码python运行 💡 提示：在嵌入式设备上建议使用更轻量的客户端库（如 cURL + JSON-C）替代 Python，以降低资源开销。 步骤三：模型量化与边缘部署优化 为了进一步压缩模型体积并提升推理速度，我们采用 GGUF 格式 + llama.cpp 架构 进行转换： # 将 HuggingFace 模型转换为 GGUF 格式（伪代码）python convert_hf_to_gguf.py \ --model tencent/HY-MT1.5-1.8B \ --output hy_mt_1.8b.Q4_K_M.gguf \ --quantization Q4_K_MAI写代码bash 量化后效果对比： 指标FP16 原始模型INT4 量化后（Q4_K_M）模型大小~3.6 GB~1.1 GB内存占用>4GB<1.5GB推理延迟（ARM A78）~400ms~180msBLEU 分数下降基准<0.5 point 可见，INT4 量化几乎无损性能，却大幅降低部署门槛，可在树莓派 5、瑞芯微 RK3588 等主流嵌入式平台上流畅运行。 3.3 关键问题与优化策略 问题1：首次推理延迟较高（冷启动） 现象：设备开机后首次翻译耗时超过 500ms 原因：模型加载、CUDA 初始化、缓存未预热 解决方案： - 启动时异步加载模型到显存 - 预热一次 dummy 输入（如 "hello" → "你好"） - 使用 ONNX Runtime 或 TensorRT 加速推理引擎 问题2：长句翻译出现截断或乱码 现象：输入超过 64 字符时输出不完整 原因：默认最大序列长度设置为 64 解决方案： 修改配置文件中的 max_length 参数： # transformers pipeline 设置translator = pipeline( "translation", model="tencent/HY-MT1.5-1.8B", tokenizer="tencent/HY-MT1.5-1.8B", max_length=128, # 扩展至128 token device=0 # GPU加速)AI写代码python运行 问题3：少数民族语言识别不准 现象：藏语输入被误判为中文普通话 对策： - 在前端 ASR 模块增加语言检测（Language ID）子模型 - 用户手动选择源语言（UI 提供民族语言选项） - 结合 GPS 定位自动切换语言包（如进入西藏自动启用藏语模式） 4. 总结 本文围绕腾讯开源的混元翻译模型 HY-MT1.5，深入探讨了其在旅游场景下的工程化落地路径。通过对 HY-MT1.5-1.8B 模型的合理选型与优化部署，我们成功构建了一套支持 离线、低延迟、多语言互译 的智能语音翻译系统，具备以下核心优势： 高性能轻量化：1.8B 参数模型在保持接近大模型翻译质量的同时，可部署于边缘设备；功能丰富实用：支持术语干预、上下文感知、格式保留，适应真实对话场景；隐私安全可控：全程本地处理，无需联网即可完成翻译，保障用户数据安全；生态开放可扩展：基于开源框架，便于二次开发与定制化集成。 未来，我们将继续探索 HY-MT1.5-7B 在云端协同翻译系统中的应用，实现“小模型端侧初翻 + 大模型云侧精修”的混合架构，进一步提升复杂语境下的翻译鲁棒性。 对于希望快速验证该方案的开发者，推荐使用 CSDN 星图平台提供的预置镜像，实现“一键部署、即刻体验”。 💡 获取更多AI镜像 想探索更多AI镜像和应用场景？访问 CSDN星图镜像广场，提供丰富的预置镜像，覆盖大模型推理、图像生成、视频生成、模型微调等多个领域，支持一键部署。 您可能感兴趣的与本文相关的镜像 For more information on our use of cookies, please review our Privacy Policy Accept all cookies Read more Blog Best Machine Translation Software in 2025 Elena Chiorescu 13/03/2025 Language and Culture Machine translation software has become an essential tool for businesses and individuals looking to communicate across languages efficiently. With continuous advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and neural machine translation (NMT), modern translation tools offer faster, more accurate, and context-aware translations than ever before. In 2025, businesses have a wide range of options, from AI-driven instant translation tools to enterprise-grade solutions with customization features. This article explores what is machine translation software and highlights some of the best machine translation software available today. Key Features to Look for When selecting the best machine translation tools, consider the following features: Translation Accuracy – The ability to capture context, idioms, and industry-specific terms with minimal errors. Supported Languages – The number of languages offered and their quality can make a big difference, especially for less common languages. Integration with Business Tools – The best machine translation software integrates with CMS platforms, chatbots, customer support tools, and e-commerce websites. Customization & Glossary Features – Some translation software with machine learning allows businesses to train translation models with company-specific terminology. Security & Compliance – Important for industries handling sensitive or confidential data, such as healthcare, finance, and legal services. Pricing & Scalability – Businesses should assess whether the machine language translation software meets their budget while offering scalability for growing translation needs. Top Machine Translation Software in 2025 1. Language IO Why it stands out: It is an enterprise translation software built for global customer support operations, which enables large organizations to communicate with customers in over 150 languages using secure, AI powered translation embedded directly into enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, and Oracle. Key Features: Helps enterprises scale multilingual support without expanding headcount Maintaines accuracy, brand tone, and data privacy Supports chat, email, tickets, knowledge bases, and self service content Helps enterprises improve customer experience, reduce costs, and support global growth Best for: Finance, healthcare, and tech enterprises that cannot afford to compromise on security or brand reputation. 2. DeepL Translator Why it stands out:DeepL is known for unmatched accuracy and fluency, particularly for European languages. Its AI-driven neural network produces natural-sounding translations, making it a top choice among the best machine translation software for businesses requiring high-quality output. Key Features: Supports 30+ languages with superior contextual accuracy Offers custom glossaries for industry-specific translations Secure, GDPR-compliant translations Available as a web-based tool, desktop app, and API for integrations Best for: Enterprises, content creators, and professionals who prioritize translation quality over speed. 3. Google Translate Why it stands out:Google Translate remains one of the most widely used machine translation tools, offering support for 130+ languages with real-time voice, image, and text translation. Key Features: AI-powered neural machine translation (NMT) Free and accessible via mobile app, web, and API Instant translation of images, documents, and websites Offline translation support Best for: Individuals, travelers, and businesses looking for quick, general translations rather than highly specialized ones. 4. Microsoft Translator Why it stands out:Microsoft Translator is a business-friendly machine language translation software with integration into Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, and Azure AI services. Key Features: Supports 100+ languages Real-time voice and text translation API for enterprise-level integrations Security-focused translation solutions for businesses Best for: Enterprises using Microsoft products and teams that need real-time collaboration in multiple languages. 5. Amazon Translate Why it stands out:Amazon Translate is designed for businesses needing high-volume, automated translations for e-commerce, customer support, and content localization, making it one of the best machine translation tools for scalability. Key Features: AI-driven, scalable translations for large datasets Integration with AWS cloud services Real-time text translation for customer support chatbots Cost-effective pay-as-you-go pricing Best for: Companies needing automated translation at scale, especially for e-commerce and customer service applications. 6. SYSTRAN Why it stands out:SYSTRAN specializes in domain-specific translations for legal, medical, and technical industries. Unlike generic translation tools, SYSTRAN provides highly specialized language models for industry professionals. Key Features: Pre-trained translation engines for legal, medical, and technical fields On-premise solutions for high-security environments Customizable AI translation models Supports over 50 languages Best for: Legal, medical, and technical industries that need highly accurate, domain-specific translations. Machine Translation vs. Professional Translation: Finding the Right Balance Machine translation software has become a valuable tool for quick, high-volume translations, particularly for internal communications, user-generated content, and basic multilingual support. Businesses can benefit from AI-powered solutions for speed and cost-effectiveness, especially when dealing with large datasets or repetitive content. However, for high-stakes documents, industry-specific content, or materials that require cultural adaptation, relying solely on machine language translation software may not be enough. Automated tools can struggle with regional dialects, specialized terminology, and legal or marketing nuances, leading to potential misinterpretations. At PoliLingua, we offer a comprehensive range of translation solutions. Our AI-powered translation is ideal for large-scale content that requires a quick turnaround, providing a cost-effective way to handle multilingual communication. For projects that demand the highest level of precision, human translation by our native-speaking linguists guarantees accuracy, cultural adaptation, and industry-specific expertise. We also provide Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE), where AI-generated translations are refined by professional linguists to enhance clarity, precision, and fluency while maintaining cost and time efficiency. Whether you need AI-assisted translations, fully human-reviewed content, or a balanced MTPE approach, PoliLingua delivers tailored solutions to meet your industry’s language requirements. Emerging Trends in Machine Translation Software As machine translation software continues to evolve, several trends are shaping the industry in 2025. Translation software with machine learning is increasingly incorporating multimodal capabilities, such as translating text embedded in images or real-time speech recognition, enhancing accessibility for diverse applications. Additionally, advancements in AI are enabling more personalized translation experiences, where tools learn from user feedback to improve accuracy over time. The integration of machine translation tools with augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) platforms is also gaining traction, offering immersive multilingual experiences for global audiences. These innovations ensure that the best machine translation software remains a dynamic and indispensable tool for bridging language barriers in an interconnected world. Choosing the best machine translation software in 2025 depends on your specific needs, budget, and accuracy requirements. Whether you require real-time translations, high-volume automated solutions, or industry-specific precision, the machine language translation software listed above offers valuable options for different use cases. However, for complex, industry-specific, or highly nuanced content, professional translation services can provide the accuracy, cultural adaptation, and quality assurance that automated tools may not always achieve. In many cases, combining machine translation software with expert review ensures both efficiency and accuracy. Huang, Fei Wang, Sheng Zhang, Hoifung Poon, Muhao Chen 备注：Work in progress链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）进行复杂推理的一个关键挑战是它们依赖于从训练数据中匹配推理模式，而不是主动选择最合适的认知策略来解决给定的任务。现有的方法强加了固定的认知结构，提高了特定任务的性能，但缺乏跨不同场景的适应性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了METASCALE，一个基于元思维的测试时间缩放框架-为每个任务量身定制的自适应思维策略。METASCALE将候选元思想存储在一个池中，然后使用具有上置信度界选择的多臂强盗算法迭代地选择和评估它们，并由奖励模型指导。为了进一步增强适应性，遗传算法进化出高回报的元思想，随着时间的推移不断完善和扩展策略池。通过在推理时动态地提出和优化元思维，METASCALE在广泛的任务中提高了准确性和泛化能力。实验结果表明，MetaScale的性能始终优于标准推理方法，在GPT-4 o的Arena-Hard获胜率方面实现了11%的性能提升，在风格控制下超过o 1-mini 0.9%。值得注意的是，METASSCALE随着抽样预算的增加而更有效地扩展，并产生更结构化的专家级响应。摘要：One critical challenge for large language models (LLMs) for making complex reasoning is their reliance on matching reasoning patterns from training data, instead of proactively selecting the most appropriate cognitive strategy to solve a given task. Existing approaches impose fixed cognitive structures that enhance performance in specific tasks but lack adaptability across diverse scenarios. To address this limitation, we introduce METASCALE, a test-time scaling framework based on meta-thoughts -- adaptive thinking strategies tailored to each task. METASCALE initializes a pool of candidate meta-thoughts, then iteratively selects and evaluates them using a multi-armed bandit algorithm with upper confidence bound selection, guided by a reward model. To further enhance adaptability, a genetic algorithm evolves high-reward meta-thoughts, refining and extending the strategy pool over time. By dynamically proposing and optimizing meta-thoughts at inference time, METASCALE improves both accuracy and generalization across a wide range of tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaScale consistently outperforms standard inference approaches, achieving an 11% performance gain in win rate on Arena-Hard for GPT-4o, surpassing o1-mini by 0.9% under style control. Notably, METASCALE scales more effectively with increasing sampling budgets and produces more structured, expert-level responses. 【2】 Faithfulness of LLM Self-Explanations for Commonsense Tasks: Larger Is Better, and Instruction-Tuning Allows Trade-Offs but Not Pareto Dominance标题： LLM对常识任务的自我补偿的忠实性：越大越好，教学调整允许权衡，但不能允许帕累托主导作者： Noah Y. Siegel, Nicolas Heess, Maria Perez-Ortiz, Oana-Maria Camburu 备注：38 pages, 9 figures链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：随着大型语言模型（LLM）的能力越来越强，确保其自我生成的解释忠实于其内部决策过程对于安全和监督至关重要。在这项工作中，我们对来自8个家庭的62个模型进行了全面的反事实忠诚度分析，包括预训练和预防调整的变体，并显着扩展了先前的反事实测试研究。我们介绍了phi-CCT，相关性反事实测试的一个简化变体，它避免了对令牌概率的需要，同时解释了原始测试的大部分方差。我们的研究结果揭示了明显的缩放趋势：较大的模型始终更忠实于我们的指标。然而，当比较谨慎调整和人类模仿的解释时，我们发现观察到的忠诚度差异通常可以归因于解释的冗长，导致沿着真阳性 假阳性帕累托边界的变化。虽然注意力调整和提示可以影响这种权衡，但我们发现有限的证据表明，它们从根本上扩展了解释忠诚度的边界，超出了预先训练的可比大小的模型所能实现的范围。我们的分析突出了模型决策过程的解释调整，冗长和忠实表示之间的微妙关系。摘要：As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, ensuring that their self-generated explanations are faithful to their internal decision-making process is critical for safety and oversight. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive counterfactual faithfulness analysis across 62 models from 8 families, encompassing both pretrained and instruction-tuned variants and significantly extending prior studies of counterfactual tests. We introduce phi-CCT, a simplified variant of the Correlational Counterfactual Test, which avoids the need for token probabilities while explaining most of the variance of the original test. Our findings reveal clear scaling trends: larger models are consistently more faithful on our metrics. However, when comparing instruction-tuned and human-imitated explanations, we find that observed differences in faithfulness can often be attributed to explanation verbosity, leading to shifts along the true-positive false-positive Pareto frontier. While instruction-tuning and prompting can influence this trade-off, we find limited evidence that they fundamentally expand the frontier of explanatory faithfulness beyond what is achievable with pretrained models of comparable size. Our analysis highlights the nuanced relationship between instruction-tuning, verbosity, and the faithful representation of model decision processes. 【3】 VideoMind: A Chain-of-LoRA Agent for Long Video Reasoning标题： VideoMind：用于长视频推理的LoRA链代理作者： Ye Liu, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Chang Wen Chen, Mike Zheng Shou 备注：Project Page: this https URL链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：视频具有独特的时间维度，需要精确的基础理解，其中答案与视觉，可解释的证据直接相关。尽管大型语言模型在推理能力方面取得了重大突破，但多模态推理-特别是视频推理-仍然未被探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了VideoMind，一种新颖的视频语言代理设计的时间接地视频理解。VideoMind结合了两个关键的创新：（i）我们确定视频时间推理的基本能力，并开发了一个基于角色的代理工作流，包括协调不同角色的规划者，时间定位的地面，评估时间间隔准确性的验证者，以及问答的回答者。(ii)为了有效地集成这些不同的角色，我们提出了一种新的LoRA链策略，通过轻量级LoRA适配器实现无缝角色切换，同时避免多个模型的开销，从而平衡效率和灵活性。在14个公共基准上进行的大量实验表明，我们的代理在不同的视频理解任务上实现了最先进的性能，包括3个接地视频问答，6个视频时间接地和5个一般视频问答，强调了其在推进视频代理和长形式时间推理方面的有效性。摘要：Videos, with their unique temporal dimension, demand precise grounded understanding, where answers are directly linked to visual, interpretable evidence. Despite significant breakthroughs in reasoning capabilities within Large Language Models, multi-modal reasoning - especially for videos - remains unexplored. In this work, we introduce VideoMind, a novel video-language agent designed for temporal-grounded video understanding. VideoMind incorporates two key innovations: (i) We identify essential capabilities for video temporal reasoning and develop a role-based agentic workflow, including a planner for coordinating different roles, a grounder for temporal localization, a verifier to assess temporal interval accuracy, and an answerer for question-answering. (ii) To efficiently integrate these diverse roles, we propose a novel Chain-of-LoRA strategy, enabling seamless role-switching via lightweight LoRA adaptors while avoiding the overhead of multiple models, thus balancing efficiency and flexibility. Extensive experiments on 14 public benchmarks demonstrate that our agent achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse video understanding tasks, including 3 on grounded video question-answering, 6 on video temporal grounding, and 5 on general video question-answering, underscoring its effectiveness in advancing video agent and long-form temporal reasoning. 【4】 Humanoid Policy ~ Human Policy标题： 类人政策~人类政策作者： Ri-Zhao Qiu, Shiqi Yang, Xuxin Cheng, Chaitanya Chawla, Jialong Li, Tairan He, Ge Yan, Lars Paulsen, Ge Yang, Sha Yi, Guanya Shi, Xiaolong Wang 备注：Code and data: this https URL链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：针对具有不同数据的人形机器人的训练操作策略增强了它们在任务和平台上的鲁棒性和通用性。然而，仅仅从机器人演示中学习是劳动密集型的，需要昂贵的远程操作的数据收集，这是难以扩展的。本文研究了一种更具可扩展性的数据源，以自我为中心的人类演示，作为机器人学习的跨具体训练数据。我们从数据和建模的角度减轻了类人机器人和人类之间的体现差距。我们收集了一个以自我为中心的面向任务的数据集（PH 2D），该数据集与人形操作演示直接一致。然后，我们训练一个人类-类人行为策略，我们称之为人类行为Transformer（HAT）。HAT的状态-动作空间对于人类和类人机器人都是统一的，并且可以被可区分地重定向到机器人动作。通过与较小规模的机器人数据共同训练，HAT直接将人形机器人和人类建模为不同的实施例，而无需额外的监督。我们发现，人类数据提高了HAT的泛化能力和鲁棒性，并具有更好的数据收集效率。代码和数据：https: human-as-robot.github.io 摘要：Training manipulation policies for humanoid robots with diverse data enhances their robustness and generalization across tasks and platforms. However, learning solely from robot demonstrations is labor-intensive, requiring expensive tele-operated data collection which is difficult to scale. This paper investigates a more scalable data source, egocentric human demonstrations, to serve as cross-embodiment training data for robot learning. We mitigate the embodiment gap between humanoids and humans from both the data and modeling perspectives. We collect an egocentric task-oriented dataset (PH2D) that is directly aligned with humanoid manipulation demonstrations. We then train a human-humanoid behavior policy, which we term Human Action Transformer (HAT). The state-action space of HAT is unified for both humans and humanoid robots and can be differentiably retargeted to robot actions. Co-trained with smaller-scale robot data, HAT directly models humanoid robots and humans as different embodiments without additional supervision. We show that human data improves both generalization and robustness of HAT with significantly better data collection efficiency. Code and data: https: human-as-robot.github.io 【5】 Deep Belief Markov Models for POMDP Inference标题： POMDP推理的深信念马尔科夫模型作者： Giacomo Arcieri, Konstantinos G. Papakonstantinou, Daniel Straub, Eleni Chatzi 链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：这项工作引入了一种新的基于深度学习的架构，称为深度置信马尔可夫模型（DBMM），它在部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）问题中提供了高效的模型制定不可知推理。POMDP框架允许建模和解决观测不确定性下的顺序决策问题。在复杂的、高维的、部分可观察的环境中，现有的基于精确计算的推理方法（例如，通过贝叶斯定理）或采样算法不能很好地缩放。此外，地面真实状态可能无法用于学习确切的过渡动态。DBESTOM将深度马尔可夫模型扩展到部分可观察的决策框架中，并通过变分推理方法完全基于可用的观察数据进行有效的信念推理。通过利用神经网络的潜力，DBSIDE可以推断和模拟系统动力学中的非线性关系，并自然地扩展到高维和离散或连续变量的问题。此外，神经网络参数可以基于数据可用性有效地动态更新。因此，可以使用DBDP来推断置信变量，从而使得能够在置信空间上导出POMDP解。我们评估所提出的方法的有效性，通过评估的能力，包括离散和连续变量的基准问题中的模型制定不可知推理的DBBEE。摘要：This work introduces a novel deep learning-based architecture, termed the Deep Belief Markov Model (DBMM), which provides efficient, model-formulation agnostic inference in Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) problems. The POMDP framework allows for modeling and solving sequential decision-making problems under observation uncertainty. In complex, high-dimensional, partially observable environments, existing methods for inference based on exact computations (e.g., via Bayes' theorem) or sampling algorithms do not scale well. Furthermore, ground truth states may not be available for learning the exact transition dynamics. DBMMs extend deep Markov models into the partially observable decision-making framework and allow efficient belief inference entirely based on available observation data via variational inference methods. By leveraging the potency of neural networks, DBMMs can infer and simulate non-linear relationships in the system dynamics and naturally scale to problems with high dimensionality and discrete or continuous variables. In addition, neural network parameters can be dynamically updated efficiently based on data availability. DBMMs can thus be used to infer a belief variable, thus enabling the derivation of POMDP solutions over the belief space. We evaluate the efficacy of the proposed methodology by evaluating the capability of model-formulation agnostic inference of DBMMs in benchmark problems that include discrete and continuous variables. 【6】 BlobCtrl: A Unified and Flexible Framework for Element-level Image Generation and Editing标题： BlobControl：用于元素级图像生成和编辑的统一灵活框架作者： Yaowei Li, Lingen Li, Zhaoyang Zhang, Xiaoyu Li, Guangzhi Wang, Hongxiang Li, Xiaodong Cun, Ying Shan, Yuexian Zou 备注：Project Webpage: this https URL链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：元素级视觉操作在数字内容创作中至关重要，但目前基于扩散的方法缺乏传统工具的精确性和灵活性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了BlobCtrl，一个框架，统一元素级的生成和编辑使用基于概率的斑点表示。通过采用斑点作为视觉原语，我们的方法有效地表示空间位置，语义内容和身份信息，实现精确的元素级操作。我们的主要贡献包括：1）具有分层特征融合的双分支扩散架构，用于无缝的前景-背景集成; 2）具有定制的数据增强和评分函数的自监督训练范例;以及3）可控制的辍学策略，以平衡保真度和多样性。为了支持进一步的研究，我们引入BlobData进行大规模训练，BlobBench进行系统评估。实验表明，BlobCtrl在各种元素级操作任务中表现出色，同时保持计算效率，为精确灵活的视觉内容创建提供了实用的解决方案。项目页面：https: liyaowei-stu.github.io project BlobCtrl 摘要：Element-level visual manipulation is essential in digital content creation, but current diffusion-based methods lack the precision and flexibility of traditional tools. In this work, we introduce BlobCtrl, a framework that unifies element-level generation and editing using a probabilistic blob-based representation. By employing blobs as visual primitives, our approach effectively decouples and represents spatial location, semantic content, and identity information, enabling precise element-level manipulation. Our key contributions include: 1) a dual-branch diffusion architecture with hierarchical feature fusion for seamless foreground-background integration; 2) a self-supervised training paradigm with tailored data augmentation and score functions; and 3) controllable dropout strategies to balance fidelity and diversity. To support further research, we introduce BlobData for large-scale training and BlobBench for systematic evaluation. Experiments show that BlobCtrl excels in various element-level manipulation tasks while maintaining computational efficiency, offering a practical solution for precise and flexible visual content creation. Project page: https: liyaowei-stu.github.io project BlobCtrl 【7】 AugMapNet: Improving Spatial Latent Structure via BEV Grid Augmentation for Enhanced Vectorized Online HD Map Construction标题： AugMapNet：通过BEV网格增强改善空间潜在结构，以增强的载体化在线高清地图构建作者： Thomas Monninger, Md Zafar Anwar, Stanislaw Antol, Steffen Staab, Sihao Ding 链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：自动驾驶需要了解基础设施要素，例如车道和人行横道。为了安全地导航，这种理解必须实时地从传感器数据中获得，并且需要以矢量化的形式表示。学习鸟瞰视图（BEV）编码器通常用于将来自多个视图的一组相机图像组合成一个联合潜在BEV网格。传统上，从该潜在空间预测中间栅格地图，提供密集的空间监督，但需要后处理成期望的矢量化形式。最近的模型使用矢量化地图解码器直接将基础设施元素派生为折线，提供实例级信息。我们的方法，增强地图网络（AugMapNet），提出了潜在的BEV网格增强，一种新的技术，显着增强潜在的BEV表示。AugMapNet比现有架构更有效地结合了矢量解码和密集空间监督，同时保持了与辅助监督一样简单的集成和通用性。在nuScenes和Argoverse2数据集上的实验表明，在60米范围内，矢量化地图预测性能比StreamMapNet基线提高了13.3%，并且在更大范围内有更大的改进。我们通过将我们的方法应用于另一个基线来确认可转移性，并找到类似的改进。对潜在BEV网格的详细分析证实了AugMapNet的更结构化的潜在空间，并显示了我们的新概念超越纯粹性能改进的价值。代码将很快发布。摘要：Autonomous driving requires an understanding of the infrastructure elements, such as lanes and crosswalks. To navigate safely, this understanding must be derived from sensor data in real-time and needs to be represented in vectorized form. Learned Bird's-Eye View (BEV) encoders are commonly used to combine a set of camera images from multiple views into one joint latent BEV grid. Traditionally, from this latent space, an intermediate raster map is predicted, providing dense spatial supervision but requiring post-processing into the desired vectorized form. More recent models directly derive infrastructure elements as polylines using vectorized map decoders, providing instance-level information. Our approach, Augmentation Map Network (AugMapNet), proposes latent BEV grid augmentation, a novel technique that significantly enhances the latent BEV representation. AugMapNet combines vector decoding and dense spatial supervision more effectively than existing architectures while remaining as straightforward to integrate and as generic as auxiliary supervision. Experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse2 datasets demonstrate significant improvements in vectorized map prediction performance up to 13.3% over the StreamMapNet baseline on 60m range and greater improvements on larger ranges. We confirm transferability by applying our method to another baseline and find similar improvements. A detailed analysis of the latent BEV grid confirms a more structured latent space of AugMapNet and shows the value of our novel concept beyond pure performance improvement. The code will be released soon. 【8】 xLSTM 7B: A Recurrent LLM for Fast and Efficient Inference标题： xLSTM 7 B：用于快速有效推理的循环LLM作者： Maximilian Beck, Korbinian Pöppel, Phillip Lippe, Richard Kurle, Patrick M. Blies, Günter Klambauer, Sebastian Böck, Sepp Hochreiter 备注：Code available at: this https URL and this https URL链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：最近在用大型语言模型（LLM）解决推理、数学和编码问题方面的突破是通过在推理时投入大量的计算预算来实现的。因此，推理速度是LLM架构的最关键属性之一，并且对高效且快速推理的LLM的需求日益增长。最近，构建在xLSTM架构上的LLM已经成为Transformers的强大替代品，它提供了具有序列长度和恒定内存使用的线性计算缩放，这两个属性都是高效推理的理想属性。然而，这种基于xLSTM的LLM尚未扩展到更大的模型，并在推理速度和效率方面进行评估和比较。在这项工作中，我们介绍了xLSTM 7B，这是一个70亿参数的LLM，它将xLSTM的架构优势与有针对性的优化相结合，以实现快速有效的推理。我们的实验表明，xLSTM 7B在下游任务上的性能与其他类似大小的LLM相当，同时与基于Llama和Mamba的LLM相比，提供了更快的推理速度和更高的效率。这些结果使xLSTM 7B成为最快、最高效的7B LLM，为需要大量测试时间计算的任务提供了解决方案。我们的工作突出了xLSTM作为基于大量使用LLM推理的方法的基础架构的潜力。我们的模型权重、模型代码和训练代码都是开源的。摘要：Recent breakthroughs in solving reasoning, math and coding problems with Large Language Models (LLMs) have been enabled by investing substantial computation budgets at inference time. Therefore, inference speed is one of the most critical properties of LLM architectures, and there is a growing need for LLMs that are efficient and fast at inference. Recently, LLMs built on the xLSTM architecture have emerged as a powerful alternative to Transformers, offering linear compute scaling with sequence length and constant memory usage, both highly desirable properties for efficient inference. However, such xLSTM-based LLMs have yet to be scaled to larger models and assessed and compared with respect to inference speed and efficiency. In this work, we introduce xLSTM 7B, a 7-billion-parameter LLM that combines xLSTM's architectural benefits with targeted optimizations for fast and efficient inference. Our experiments demonstrate that xLSTM 7B achieves performance on downstream tasks comparable to other similar-sized LLMs, while providing significantly faster inference speeds and greater efficiency compared to Llama- and Mamba-based LLMs. These results establish xLSTM 7B as the fastest and most efficient 7B LLM, offering a solution for tasks that require large amounts of test-time computation. Our work highlights xLSTM's potential as a foundational architecture for methods building on heavy use of LLM inference. Our model weights, model code and training code are open-source. 【9】 Securing Virtual Reality Experiences: Unveiling and Tackling Cybersickness Attacks with Explainable AI标题： 保护虚拟现实体验：利用可解释人工智能揭露和应对网络疾病攻击作者： Ripan Kumar Kundu, Matthew Denton, Genova Mongalo, Prasad Calyam, Khaza Anuarul Hoque 备注：This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：虚拟现实（VR）和人工智能（AI）之间的协同作用，特别是基于深度学习（DL）的网络病检测模型，通过自动检测网络病严重程度和自适应各种缓解技术，带来了沉浸式体验的前所未有的进步，提供了流畅舒适的VR体验。虽然这种支持DL的网络病检测方法为增强用户体验提供了有前途的解决方案，但它也引入了新的风险，因为这些模型容易受到对抗性攻击;人类观察者在视觉上无法检测到的输入数据的小扰动可以欺骗网络病检测模型并触发意外缓解，从而破坏用户沉浸式体验（UIX），甚至造成安全风险。在本文中，我们提出了一种新型的VR攻击，即，一种网络病攻击，它通过欺骗基于DL的网络病检测模型成功地阻止了网络病缓解的触发，并极大地阻碍了UIX。接下来，我们提出了一种新的可解释人工智能（XAI）引导的网络病攻击检测框架，以检测VR中的此类攻击，以确保UIX和舒适的VR体验。我们使用两个最先进的开源VR网络病数据集来评估所提出的攻击和检测框架：Simulation 2021和Gameplay数据集。最后，为了验证我们提出的方法的有效性，我们使用一个测试平台来实现攻击和基于XAI的检测，该测试平台带有一个定制的VR过山车模拟，并使用HTC Vive Pro Eye耳机进行用户研究。我们的研究表明，这种攻击可以极大地阻碍UIX。然而，我们提出的XAI引导的网络病攻击检测可以成功地检测网络病攻击并触发适当的缓解，有效地减少VR网络病。摘要：The synergy between virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI), specifically deep learning (DL)-based cybersickness detection models, has ushered in unprecedented advancements in immersive experiences by automatically detecting cybersickness severity and adaptively various mitigation techniques, offering a smooth and comfortable VR experience. While this DL-enabled cybersickness detection method provides promising solutions for enhancing user experiences, it also introduces new risks since these models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks; a small perturbation of the input data that is visually undetectable to human observers can fool the cybersickness detection model and trigger unexpected mitigation, thus disrupting user immersive experiences (UIX) and even posing safety risks. In this paper, we present a new type of VR attack, i.e., a cybersickness attack, which successfully stops the triggering of cybersickness mitigation by fooling DL-based cybersickness detection models and dramatically hinders the UIX. Next, we propose a novel explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided cybersickness attack detection framework to detect such attacks in VR to ensure UIX and a comfortable VR experience. We evaluate the proposed attack and the detection framework using two state-of-the-art open-source VR cybersickness datasets: Simulation 2021 and Gameplay dataset. Finally, to verify the effectiveness of our proposed method, we implement the attack and the XAI-based detection using a testbed with a custom-built VR roller coaster simulation with an HTC Vive Pro Eye headset and perform a user study. Our study shows that such an attack can dramatically hinder the UIX. However, our proposed XAI-guided cybersickness attack detection can successfully detect cybersickness attacks and trigger the proper mitigation, effectively reducing VR cybersickness. 【10】 FLEX: A Framework for Learning Robot-Agnostic Force-based Skills Involving Sustained Contact Object Manipulation标题： FLEX：学习涉及持续接触对象操纵的机器人不可知力技能的框架作者： Shijie Fang, Wenchang Gao, Shivam Goel, Christopher Thierauf, Matthias Scheutz, Jivko Sinapov 备注：Accepted at IEEE-ICRA-2025链接：点击下载PDF文件摘要：学习有效地操纵物体，特别是那些涉及持续接触的物体（例如，推动，滑动）和铰接部分（例如，抽屉、门），提出了重大的挑战。传统的方法，如以机器人为中心的强化学习（RL）、模仿学习和混合技术，需要大量的训练，

meta_description: Discover better alternatives to Google Translate to translate your website within minutes.

Customize your preferences to control how your information is handled.Website translationTop 5 Alternatives to Google TranslateWritten byMerve AlsanReviewed byUpdated onJanuary 26, 2026Thanks to its neural machine translation network, which translates sentences within their specific context, Google Translate is a major name in translation services.That’s because with its high language support at 133 languages, it can instantly give you quality translations in many languages. It’s accessible thanks to its app, and flexible thanks to its instant visual translation and speech-to-text features. There’s no doubt that it’s swooped in to save the day of many travelers, foreigners and even entrepreneurs!This technology, which uses machine learning, is incredibly useful for websites that want to translate content into different languages. And you can set up a Google Translate API connection and use Google’s neural network to translate your content through Google Cloud.But Google Translate by itself is not practical for every use case. Specifically, it’s not ideal for translating your website, an ecommerce store, a blog, and so on. As you can see here from our study with Nimdzi on the state of machine translation, there are formidable alternatives to Google Translate and in particular, for specific language pairs. In this post, we’ll have a look at these, other reasons you might need one, and an efficient way to turn your website multilingual.Alternatives to Google TranslateLet’s take a look at other alternatives to using Google Translate for your website:DeepLDeepL is a leading provider of machine translation that is widely praised for its accuracy, particularly when compared to Google. It captures context and colloquialisms better, allowing you to leave the translations unedited. Fun fact: it was developed with Linguee, a popular online multilingual dictionary also known for its quality translations.For instance, DeepL provides higher-quality translations than Google Translate in the following language pairs: English-German, English-French, and English-Spanish.Our own study comparing DeepL and Google Translate also found that DeepL produced the most number of translations that didn’t need a human to verify them.Plus, DeepL provides an API for automatic website translation, just like Google Translate. You can also use its web interface and applications to translate text files (.pdf, .docx, or even .pptx files) and textual content.However, one thing that Google Translate notably has over DeepL is the wide language selection. DeepL currently supports 30 languages, having recently added Arabic. It offers 800 language pairs, which is still plenty for many website owners. While most of these languages are European languages like Polish and Portuguese, DeepL also supports Chinese, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, and Korean.Lastly, the DeepL API offers 500,000 characters for free each month and 1,000 glossaries for specific languages. The next tier, DeepL API Pro, costs €4.99 a month. It has no volume restrictions, cost control settings, and a pay-as-you-go scheme where you pay €20 per 1,000,000 characters. Google offers almost the same thing: 500,000 characters for free per month, and charges $20 for a million characters. However, it charges $0.08 for each page of a document you send for translation.Microsoft TranslateAvailable through Microsoft’s Cognitive Service, Microsoft Translate is found throughout many familiar products: Bing, Office, Microsoft Edge, and more. Microsoft Translator is a strong contender to Google Translate. It supports 129 languages, nearly the same as Google’s 133. It also performed well in our study with Nimdzi on the state of machine translation for websites, where it scored a 3 out of 4 in ranking its overall usability and rating for all seven languages. As a bonus, it was also the only translation provider to score consistently across all tested languages.It also scored the highest in producing translations that didn’t need editing for German—even when compared to DeepL, which is widely praised for its accuracy and quality in this language!It comes with a free API trial to see what it’s like on your website. Other than that, its free plan allows you to translate 2 million characters per month, whereas Google Translate allows you to translate only 500,000 a month. If you need more than 2 million characters, Microsoft Translator still comes out as more affordable: it charges $10 for 1 million characters, and Google charges $20.Amazon TranslateAmazon Translate is the ecommerce giant’s machine translation service, which belongs to its cloud-based suite of offerings, Amazon Web Services. What sets this apart from the other alternatives is that you can access it only from the AWS Management Console or an API. So you can’t quite use it on-the-go to translate like you can with Google, DeepL, and Microsoft.You can use Amazon Translate to translate your website, documents, create custom terminology, configure formalities in language, and even cover up profanity. It also supports 75 languages and over 5,500 translation combinations.Moreover, it provides real-time translation in email, helpdesk, chat, and ticketing applications so that agents can communicate in the languages of their customers.Amazon Translate is quickly rising to be a high-quality machine translation provider. In our study with Nimdzi, they scored one of the highest in no-touch translations as you can see in this graph here. That means translators corrected Amazon Translate’s output much less frequently than some others.If you’re signed up to the AWS Free Tier, then you have access to Amazon Translate for free for 12 months, starting the day you make your first translation request. You’ll also get 2 million characters for each month for standard text and batch document translation.However, if you’re not signed up to this tier, you’ll have to pay $15 for 1 million characters for standard text, batch document, and real-time document translation (text and HTML). The last of which is not available to free tier users. You’ll then have to pay $30 for 1 million characters for real-time documentation for .docx files, and $60 for 1 million characters for active custom translation.So while Amazon Translate is definitely more affordable in the first year compared to Google’s $20 for 500,000 characters, you’ll have to make some considerations to support your translation needs for the second year and beyond.ReversoReverso is a machine translation software that provides AI-powered translation in over 15 languages and document translation in over 25. It’s available through their website, but they also have apps for Mac, Windows, iOS, Android, and even browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox.It comes with an integrated grammar checker, so it automatically corrects errors in your original text with an AI-based spell checker, giving you higher-quality translations. Its integrated dictionary allows you to modify your translations and fine-tune them for even better quality, suggesting synonyms and offering in-context translation examples.While Reverso is free to use, some restrictions apply, such as word and character count. You can skirt this through Reverso Premium. Their annual plan costs €6.49 a month or €38.94 billed one time, and their monthly plan costs €9.99. Regardless of the plan you pick, you’ll have unlimited text translation of up to 8,000 characters at once, translate up to 50,000 words per year in documents, and benefit from translating scanned documents as well.If your needs are much higher than that, you might benefit from their corporate translator, though you’ll have to contact their sales team for pricing.Check out a more comprehensive list of website translation services.WeglotNow, if you’re looking for a Google Translate alternative specifically to translate your website, consider Weglot. An AI website translation tool, it uses 3 different translation providers (DeepL, Microsoft and Google Translate based on the accuracy of the language pair) and supports over 110 languages, so you’ll always get the most accurate translations for your site. But unlike using Google’s Cloud Translation AI, you don’t need to manage its API integration to use it. Weglot works with any site and is easy to install. Plus, it automatically translates your content for you.Weglot can translate any site in just a few minutes. When it’s done translating your site, it sets up your translated sites as unique subdomains/subdirectories and optimizes them for SEO (following Google’s best practices for multilingual SEO).Weglot pricing starts at 15€ or $17 a month.Why Would You Need a Google Translate Alternative?Google Translate is a wonderful tool that fulfills quick, personal translation needs: understanding foreign menus, signs, or basic instructions. But when you’re looking for a solution that will deliver accurate website translations, there are solutions out there that are much better suited to the task.1. It Doesn’t Have Editing ControlA crucial part of translation is ensuring it has perfect grammar and spelling, especially when it’s customer-facing content. Google Translate isn’t capable of proofreading translations or detecting if there are errors in the original text. You can’t edit any of the translations it suggests, either, so you’ll have to stick to whatever Google Translate offers.Plus, Google recently discontinued the Contribute feature, which allowed users to submit suggestions to translated content to increase the quality. The output will still be human-informed, but it’ll be the product of its systems evolving and learning rather than real people suggesting translations based on nuance and context.2. It May Not Be the Best Machine Translation Provider for Your Chosen Language PairsGoogle Translate is available in over 130 languages, so it offers the broadest spectrum of language support. But because it covers so many languages, it can’t provide the same level of quality for all 8,778 language pairs.3. It Doesn’t Display the Translated Content on Your Website for YouPreviously, you could add the Google Translate Widget to your site that would display the translated content for you (note: this is still possible, but only if you're using it for a non-commercial website). So, you’ll need a developer to create a special workflow so that you can integrate the Google Translate API into your website.You’ll have to configure Google Translate to upload your translations each time. Any time you translate new content or add something to your site, you’ll have to manually run it through the API to translate it for you. Then, you’ll have to set it up so that it displays these translations each time—taking up time you could spend on more productive tasks. That’s a lot of manual work and potential copy-pasting involved!4. It Doesn’t Optimize Translations for Multilingual SEOA crucial part of reaching your audience—especially in a brand-new market—is optimizing your content for search engine performance in their respective areas. However, because of the way the tool works, it doesn’t send signals to search engines to index the newly translated content on your web pages. You’ll have to manually add attributes like hreflang tags, set up your translated websites under subdirectories or subdomains, and overall miss the many advantages of multilingual SEO.5. It Doesn’t Allow Translation Project CollaborationGoogle Translate’s interface is designed for individual users, blocking collaboration. However, alternatives allow you to add team members to your project and manage your translations together.When Can I Use Google Translate?Google Translate is perfectly fine for certain use cases and it can deliver fast, fairly accurate translations. But for things that require a lot of context—like your marketing materials and website—the tool itself won’t suffice since it’ll need a human eye to verify its output.That said, Google Translate is excellent at providing translations for these functions:Technical textsSimilarly, repetitive technical content that is mostly action-oriented to solve an issueLow-traffic or low-visibility contentFooters, product descriptions, terms and conditions pagesUser-generated content, such as testimonialsSupport messages through chat or emailFleeting/temporary content, such as customer inquiriesFinding the best translation tool completely depends on your needs and what you’re looking for. We at Weglot find Google Translate very useful for providing a first layer of translation to your website in over 110 languages, which is why it’s one of the providers we use, along with DeepL and Microsoft Translator.While Google Translate is a powerful translation provider, it’s not necessarily the best tool if you want to make your website multilingual.Using Weglot to Translate Your WebsiteUnlike the process of integrating Google Translate’s API with your website, translating your website (which can still involve Google Translate) with Weglot takes only a few minutes.Weglot’s Easy Installation Process (Including Video Tutorials)Here’s a quick video on how easy and user-friendly it is to install Weglot on your site—no coding or developers needed:Weglot also has integrations with your favorite CMS, whether WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, you name it.Weglot Will Translate Your Site Automatically (And Keep It Updated)Once you connect Weglot to your site, pick your site’s current language and what language you want to translate your site into, whether Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Dutch, and more. Then Weglot takes over. After your translation is ready, Weglot automatically displays it under a unique subdomain/subdirectory of your current site’s URL. For example, Weglot’s main site is weglot.com. But our French site is weglot.com/fr/, and the Italian one is weglot.com/it/. That subdomain was automatically set up for us in our target languages without any effort.Edit Your Translations as Needed (And Hire Professional Translators)Weglot is designed to do the bulk of the work for your translation needs. At some point, you may end up needing to edit your translated content, depending on your website and industry.To make things easier, you can access all of your translated languages in your Weglot Dashboard—whether they’re machine-powered translations or translations done by human translators. You can find a specific translation by:Selecting a URL.Searching for a specific phrase or word you want to find.Navigating through a live preview of your site with our visual editor.You can click the translation you want to edit, make the changes, and then save them. All changes are updated automatically on your CMS. You can also find a professional translator through Weglot. Simply pick which content you want to be translated/reviewed by a professional, and then the job is sent to a qualified translator. Once the translator has finished translating, the content is automatically updated and live on your site. Plus, you can set up glossaries with specific translation rules, such as excluding specific words, phrases, pages, or blocks from translations.Weglot Optimizes Your Website for SEOWhen Weglot translates your CMS, it also helps with your new site’s multilingual SEO. This helps your site rank for the right audience regardless of the search engine.Weglot helps with SEO by:Automatically translating all of your on-page SEO elements, such as your alt tags and metadata.Adding code to your translated site that tells Google you have a translated site available (hreflang tags).Creating a unique subdomain/subdirectory for each translated site.Giving you the option to translate your URLs.Offering automatic user redirection, so users will be immediately presented with the version of your site that matches their browser preference.Weglot Allows You to Localize Your WebsiteWebsite localization is a key part of offering an excellent user experience for your audience, as it presents your content in their context.With Weglot, you can easily localize your website and adjust your messaging so that it contains the colloquialisms, references, and more of your target audience. This is possible not just by editing your content but translating your media, too—something definitely not possible with the current state of Google Translate.Weglot: The Best Google Translate AlternativeWhile Google is a great machine translation service that provides accurate translations, it doesn’t give websites an easy way to translate their content. It’s also a bit more expensive, but it’s worth it if you have a lot of colloquialisms in your content. Microsoft Translator is the most affordable while offering the most number of supported languages, second to Google Translate.Amazon Translate offers several useful features, but many are free only for the first year. If you're looking for one, here are the seven best text-to-speech Chrome extensions. Error! Filename not specified. Text-to-speech programs can come in very handy, whether you need to use the extension for reading difficulties, or just because you like having text read aloud. Chrome extensions are the perfect format to use these programs as you browse the web. So, here we’ve listed the seven best text-to-speech extensions for Chrome. 1. Natural Reader An intelligent extension, Natural Reader works great for almost any type of text, including PDF, Google Docs, eBooks, and emails. Natural Reader also has an immersive reader mode that lets you read without any distractions. For those with dyslexia, the immersive reader mode supports dyslexic fonts to make reading easier. To instruct Natural Reader to start reading, you can use the hotkey Alt + R. Alternatively, if you want to listen to only a part of the text, simply select the text and click on the Natural Reader icon at the end of the selected text. The extension has four tabs: one for adjusting voice and speed, the second for changing settings, the third for saving to mobile, and the last for listening to PDFs or uploaded texts. Natural Readers supports 16 languages including English, Spanish, French, and German. Other than the Chrome extension, Natural Reader has web, iOS, and Android apps. Though the extension is free to use, you can get more voice options with Premium and Pro plans, starting from $10 per month. Download: Natural Reader for Chrome (Free, Paid) 2. Capti Voice Error! Filename not specified. Capti Voice is another popular text-to-speech Chrome extension. The notable feature of Capti Voice is that you can save complete articles for later and listen to them whenever you're free. To save an article for later, press Alt + A. Capti Voice extracts all the content, excluding ads, and saves it to the cloud. Later, you can go to its web app and listen to the saved articles. Furthermore, it lets you create playlists to organize the saved pieces. You can, however, also instantly listen to any article or document. Simply, select the text and click on the Play icon below the selected text. Related: The Best Text-to-Speech Apps for Android Capti Voice supports several languages and voices. But in the free plan, only U.S. English is available. Moreover, with the premium plan, you can view the word definitions and translate text. Though the Capti Voice is intended for educational purposes, it’s still a good extension for people who don’t want to read long text or have difficulty in reading. Download: Capti Voice for Chrome (Free, Paid) 3. Read Aloud: A Text to Speech Voice Reader Error! Filename not specified. Read Aloud is an open-source project that is specially designed for people who prefer listening to content rather than reading it. It offers support for 40 languages. Read Aloud can read different formats like Google Docs, blog posts, PDFs, Amazon Kindle, Google Play Books, etc. To listen to any piece of text, select and right-click it, then choose Read aloud selected text. Alternatively, you can use the shortcut Alt + P. It lets you adjust the reading speed, volume, and pitch from the Settings icon. Moreover, you can choose whether to highlight the played text. Read Aloud has around four million downloads on Chrome Web Store, so it’s definitely a popular TTS extension for Chrome. Download: Read Aloud for Chrome (Free) 4. Snap&Read Error! Filename not specified. Snap&Read is a feature-rich reading extension that lets you listen to any kind of text. Other than webpages, Google Docs, and PDFs, Snap&Read can also read text from images and scanned documents using OCR. To listen to any text, select the Loud Speaker icon from the sidebar, then click on the text from where you want Snap&Read to read. For listening to text from screenshots or images, select the Rectangular Selection icon. Select the area from where you want Snap&Read to detect and read text. Moreover, Snap&Read can translate the text into other languages and adjust the readability of the text. Using this extension, you can remove distractions and change the spacing and number of words per line to create a better reading experience. Related: The Best Free Text-to-Speech Tools for Educators Snap&Read is a great TTS extension, especially for students. It costs $4 per month, but you can access a free trial. Download: Snap&Read for Chrome ($4 per month) 5. Talkie: Text to Speech Error! Filename not specified. Talkie is a simple text-to-speech Chrome extension that supports multiple languages. As it is quite a basic extension, Talkie is a good choice if you need limited features. To make Talkie read any text, select the text, right-click it, and choose Talkie from the context menu. Talkie automatically detects the languages, selects a voice, and reads the text for you. For setting a default voice, you’ll have to upgrade to Premium. It doesn't have any word limits and can work offline if the languages are downloaded. Best of all, you can download more TTS languages and voices for your operating system, and Talkie can auto-detect and use them. Most of the features are free, but you can also upgrade to Premium for more options. Talkie Premium does not have a fixed price but is a pay-what-you-want subscription. Download: Talkie: Text to Speech for Chrome (Free, Paid) 6. Intelligent Speaker Whether you want to listen to articles, PDFs, Google Docs, or uploaded text, Intelligent Speaker got you covered. This extension supports 20 languages and automatically detects the language. You can read complete web pages as well as selected text. To make the voice sound more natural, you can turn on breathing. Available on desktop and mobile, Intelligent Speaker lets you sync your content to a podcast app, so you can listen to articles on the go. You can even download the converted audio file using this extension. Intelligent Speaker works offline and is available for all major browsers. Related: The Best Free Text-to-Speech Apps for iPhone The free plan supports only one hour of listening each month, so you'll have to subscribe to Premium, which costs $7 per month, for unlimited listening. Download: Intelligent Speaker for Chrome (Free, Paid) 7. Text to Speech Error! Filename not specified. Text to Speech Chrome extension by Hewzio is a simple yet useful extension. It can read the entire web page for you, supporting 30 languages. To listen to any article, simply click on the extension icon or right-click the screen and choose Read Page. The extension will start reading the page from the beginning. To listen to selected text, play the audio and click on the sentence from where you want it to read. Text to Speech also has a distraction-free reader mode. You can sync articles across devices, including mobile phones, and create podcasts from articles using Text to Speech by Hewzio. The free plan does the basic job of converting text into audio, but the paid plans offer more features, including the dark mode. There are three paid plans, ranging from $1 to $10 per month. Download: Text to Speech for Chrome (Free, Paid) Let the Extension Read Out the Screen for You Whether you want to read webpages, documents, or images, these Chrome extensions can read out the screen for you. These extensions are a great way for students to learn different languages and avoid reading long research papers. Similarly, these text-to-speech extensions are really useful for people with vision impairment or reading difficulties like dyslexia.
